findings.problem: The app teaches the informal tú register and uses usted only on its own word card, but this card teaches the usted form 'puede' and its hint asks for formal speech.
findings.fix: es: ¿Me puedes ayudar, por favor? / hint: Informal: to a friend (tú) / example.es: Hola, ¿me puedes ayudar, por favor? No entiendo.

back.es: Can you help me, please? (formal: usted)
back.example: Hi, can you help me, please? I don't understand.

note: Other ways to say this are also correct and a learner might give them, such as '¿Puedes ayudarme, por favor?' (the pronoun placed after the verb), so the grader should accept them.
